description: Finans Norge Forventningsbarometeret main consumer confidence indicator (trend indicator), seasonally adjusted
notes: Quarterly household survey by Verian for Finans Norge (nationally representative sample of 1000 persons 15+, telephone). Published mid-quarter (2026: Q1 24 Feb, Q2 12 May, Q3 12 Aug), hence negative lag. METHOD CHANGE from 2026Q3: phone + SMS web survey, Finans Norge reports a moderate negative level shift vs the phone-only history. Data read from the Datawrapper chart embedded on the page. Main indicator = average of the 5 sub-indicator net balances (% optimists - % pessimists); seasonally adjusted by Verian since 2002. Seasonally adjusted series is revised as new quarters arrive (compared with chart v3: revisions up to 0.7pt).
